description: Grant Park to Grant Park through 29 neighbourhoods: north to Lincoln Park and Lakeview, back through the Loop, west to the West Loop, south through Little Italy, Pilsen and Chinatown, and back up Michigan Avenue. Almost flat, with small rises at the river bridges and one short climb, "Mount Roosevelt", just before the finish. Unofficial.

source.notes: 2026 course, with mile 2 on Dearborn St (State St in earlier years). Route traced over OpenStreetMap streets in race order, including the covered Lower Columbus underpass; distances calibrated to the GPS split points on the course's USATF certification (IL23038NM). Elevations from USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar (2017); river bridges, expressway overpasses and the Lower Columbus underpass are interpolated, so the small dip under Columbus Dr near the start is flattened. The only real climb is "Mount Roosevelt" in the last half-mile. Unofficial.
